summary: Examples of dict2items with default key/value names and with custom key_name='file' and value_name='path'.
questions: What does dict2items output look like?
How do I convert a dict of files to a list with file and path fields?

answer_card.title: dict2items examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
items: "{{ {'a': 1, 'b': 2} | dict2items }}"
# => [{"key": "a", "value": 1}, {"key": "b", "value": 2}]

vars:
  files:
    users: /etc/passwd
    groups: /etc/group
  files_dicts: "{{ files | dict2items(key_name='file', value_name='path') }}"
# => [{"file": "users", "path": "/etc/passwd"}, {"file": "groups", "path": "/etc/group"}]
```
